title: Finn Amano Sheets and Sheets

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Hey, hey, el capitan, la capitan-ita. La rita. Senorita. Nah, that's not right. Hard times today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, hey, el capitan, la capitan-ita. La rita. Senorita. Nah, that's not right. Hard times today.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Hey, hey, hey, my friend in the end. You got a minute? Could use an ear to get this vibe right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, hey, hey, my friend in the end. You got a minute? Could use an ear to get this vibe right.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: *humming* That's the jam. Lemmie get this... wait a minute... yup.. ok, all situated now I just gotta find the shimmer sheet - hard to read music without the music yah know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: *humming* That's the jam. Lemmie get this... wait a minute... yup.. ok, all situated now I just gotta find the shimmer sheet - hard to read music without the music yah know?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: In the warm and doughy flesh. Are you a fan? Always, always good to meet a fan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In the warm and doughy flesh. Are you a fan? Always, always good to meet a fan.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Yeah? Well isn't that just the greatest thing I've heard today. Wait - second greatest thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah? Well isn't that just the greatest thing I've heard today. Wait - second greatest thing.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: This technicolor tune: 'sliding through, down the drain and into joos. neon lights guiding you. guiding you.' Yeah, guiding you, that's it, that's the name.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This technicolor tune: 'sliding through, down the drain and into joos. neon lights guiding you. guiding you.' Yeah, guiding you, that's it, that's the name.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Feedback is always appreciated. How we make things groove better, yah know? Gotta get it right before gettin' it out there for the fans.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Feedback is always appreciated. How we make things groove better, yah know? Gotta get it right before gettin' it out there for the fans.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ah, that's amazing, and it dampens my very soul to say I can't give them one right now. Heed my words, I want nothing more than to scribble and sign for them!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, that's amazing, and it dampens my very soul to say I can't give them one right now. Heed my words, I want nothing more than to scribble and sign for them!

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: 'And long as I'm out here, sitting in an open space, figuring out my place, I'll be singing. You'll be gone and I'll be singing.'

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 'And long as I'm out here, sitting in an open space, figuring out my place, I'll be singing. You'll be gone and I'll be singing.'

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ah, tell yah what, here's something better than an autograph. Rough draft sheet music. Initial bytes and waves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, tell yah what, here's something better than an autograph. Rough draft sheet music. Initial bytes and waves.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Least I can do my friend. Least I can do. Enjoy the ride, yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Least I can do my friend. Least I can do. Enjoy the ride, yeah?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: I'm trying to pluck the perfect words from the depths of the hive mind. It's a mix and match without a latch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm trying to pluck the perfect words from the depths of the hive mind. It's a mix and match without a latch.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Bad ju-ju my non-musical friend. Can't be signing while I'm singing or the words will leave my head.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bad ju-ju my non-musical friend. Can't be signing while I'm singing or the words will leave my head.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.text: Eh, could use some work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, could use some work.

nodes.text: My friend would love an autograph. I need to give them a special gift.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Finn!

nodes.text: What's going on?
